component.name: Ship of Harkinian
component.summary: Native PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

description.p: Ship of Harkinian (SoH) is a native PC port of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, built from the ZeldaRET decompilation project. It runs the original game logic at high frame rates with widescreen support, high resolution rendering, and a wide range of quality-of-life enhancements and mod support.
This is an unofficial Flatpak wrapper around the official upstream AppImage release. It packages the already-compiled binary as-is.

IMPORTANT: This package contains no copyrighted game assets. You must supply your own legally obtained copy of the Ocarina of Time ROM. The application will prompt you to import a ROM on first launch.
Packages the upstream SoH 9.3.1 (Dewey Bravo) AppImage release.
